# Examples the block tree and our inline parser do not match yet, each with
# its bucket and reason (docs/dev/block-tree.md).
#
# Format: `<suite>/<example> <bucket>: <reason>`, the bucket one of:
#
#   blocks   the scanner reads the blocks otherwise than the spec: phase 3
#   version  CommonMark 0.31.2 reads it otherwise than GFM 0.29, which is
#            the reference (`cmark-gfm`); decided for GFM
#
# `flutter test` fails if an example outside this file fails, and fails again
# if an example inside it starts passing, so the list cannot rot.
#
# Measured 2026-10-06 with `dart run tool/tree_spec.dart --ids`.
